successor_architecture_requirement: materially different from task-level class outcome weighting
recommended_r3_thesis: counterfactual mechanism credit assignment from within-task multi-candidate comparisons
why: R2 assigned the same selected-candidate task outcome to every mapped constituent mechanism. The calibration showed only +0.015625 utility versus retrieval/shuffled, zero advantage over no-experience, and worse positive rank than retrieval. A successor should estimate marginal component effects instead of treating all components as equally responsible.
